name: Start Location
description: Choose where players start in your space with a small Visual Scripting graph and a scene object as the spawn point.
dependencies: SideQuest Creator SDK / Set Space Settings subgraph
usage: Assign the Start-Location graph to a Script Machine on the GameObject you want to use as the starting location. The On Start event calls Set Space Settings, with This connected to Spawn Object. Review the other space settings before use; the graph configures more than the spawn point.
testNotes: Maintainer approved public listing on 2026-09-15 and reported an open licence; see licence notes. Archive inspected, but no Unity, headset or multiplayer test is claimed here. Includes a sample scene and two tutorial C# scripts, including an InitializeOnLoad editor script. A Creator SDK 4.0.14 sample path is present; this is not proof of compatibility. The version is a catalogue identifier, not an author-supplied version.
